name: Wearing Earrings
overview: Scripture references earrings primarily in the context of cultural and religious practices, as seen when Jacob's household surrendered earrings along with idols (Genesis 35:4) and when earrings were collected as offerings for the Lord (Numbers 31:50). The Bible also addresses distinctions in gender roles and appearance, forbidding men from adopting women's attire or accessories, which includes earrings (Deuteronomy 22:5), highlighting a principle of honoring God through appropriate conduct. While earrings were common among various peoples, including the Ishmaelites (Judges 8:24), the Scriptures caution against practices associated with pagan mourning rituals (Leviticus 19:28) and emphasize the importance of obedience to God's commands over cultural customs.
